hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Use bitmask state to track subset of passenger requests already served.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each subset mask, maintain minimal trips and current elevator load.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Add an unserved passenger to the current ride if weight allows, or start a new elevator trip.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitmask dynamic programming evaluates optimal passenger bin packing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General bin packing is NP-hard; bitmask DP is exact and minimal for n <= 18.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size 2^n stores (trips, last_weight) tuples.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models subset partitioning into minimal capacity-constrained trips using bitmask DP.
